caption: The drawing shows a cylindrical tin or box with a slightly domed lid. The main body of the container is decorated with a blue background featuring painted scenes that include several conical white tents, some with visible openings, arranged in a row to suggest a military encampment. In the foreground, there is a prominently depicted figure wearing a uniform and hat, mounted on a horse and gesturing with one arm outstretched. The horse is light brown, and the figure is dressed in clothes of muted shades that blend into the background. Another smaller horse and rider are shown to the left of the central figure. The lower section of the tin is bordered with a dark green band featuring clusters of white and light pink flowers and foliage. Yellowish-gold trim circles the top edge of the tin, and the lid itself is a mix of brown and gold hues, with visible wear and discoloration. There is faint, painted white or gold text running across the blue area, with "GEN. TAYLOR" partially legible above the central mounted figure. The background behind the tin is plain, light beige, and unadorned. The artist's signature “WALTER DORN” is visible on the lower right of the image.
title: Bandbox
